name: 2 Hours
source:
In this short visual novel, Jordan forgot to get a gift for his friend, Greg.  He has 2 hours before the mall closes to decide what to get him. Choose one of 15 gifts from 5 stores to get the perfect gift!

[From [url=https://boredbradley.itch.io/2-hours]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部简短的视觉小说中，乔丹忘记给他的朋友格雷格买一份礼物。在商场关门前，他有2小时的时间来决定买什么。从5家商店的15件礼物中选择一件即可获得完美礼物！

[来自[url=https://boredbradley.itch.io/2-hours]itch.io[/url]]
